texts.Reporting_Builder_ColumnsHelp: Pick the fields to list. Choose a lookup followed by > to use a field of the related record, such as a gift's fund name.
texts.Reporting_Builder_ReadOnly: This report is shared with you to view. Run it, change it to try something, or use Save As to keep your own copy.
texts.Reporting_Builder_RelatedHelp: Keep only records that have, or have no, related records matching conditions, such as contacts with no gift this year.
texts.Reporting_Builder_RunFirst: Choose what to report on, then select Run to see the result here.
texts.Reporting_Builder_SummariesHelp: Add a column that counts or totals each record's related records, such as each household's gifts this year.
texts.Reporting_Builder_TotalsHelp: Add a total to count or sum records instead of listing them. Add up to two groupings to split the totals, such as by month and fund.
texts.Reporting_ChartSummary: {0}: a chart of {1} groups. The largest is {2}. Select Show Table for every value.
texts.Reporting_CutCategories: The chart shows the largest groups; Show Table lists every group.
texts.Reporting_Dash_EmptyHelp: Select Edit, then add a saved report or build a new one.
texts.Reporting_Dash_ReadOnly: This dashboard is shared with you to view. Use its filters freely, or use Save As to keep your own copy.
texts.Reporting_Delete_Body: Delete {0}? Everyone it is shared with loses it too. This cannot be undone.
texts.Reporting_Error_Definition: This report or dashboard could not be read. Open it again, or build it again if it still fails.
texts.Reporting_Error_Function: That total ({0}) is not one Advanced Reporting offers.
texts.Reporting_Error_Generic: Advanced Reporting could not do that. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Reporting_Error_Group: That field ({0}) cannot be used to group records.
texts.Reporting_Error_Measure: That field ({0}) cannot be totalled that way.
texts.Reporting_Error_NoEdit: You can view this but not change it. Use Save As to keep your own copy.
texts.Reporting_Error_NoExport: Exporting needs the Export Reports permission in Salesforce. Ask your Salesforce admin.
texts.Reporting_Error_NoSave: Saving, sharing and deleting reports and dashboards needs the Advanced Reporting Staff or Admin permission set. Ask your BarnCRM admin.
texts.Reporting_Error_NotFound: That report or dashboard is gone, or it is no longer shared with you.
texts.Reporting_Error_Object: You cannot report on that object. It is not installed, or your access does not include it.
texts.Reporting_Error_OwnerOnly: Only its owner can share or delete this.
texts.Reporting_Error_Related: Those related records ({0}) cannot be used here.
texts.Reporting_Error_ScanCurrency: This report is too large to total {0} here, because your org uses more than one currency. Add a filter or a date range so it fits, then run it again.
texts.Reporting_Error_TooManyPeople: That shares it with more than 500 people. Share it with fewer people or smaller groups.
texts.Reporting_Error_TooManyRelated: Too many related records to total. Add a filter or a date range.
texts.Reporting_ExportCapped: Exported the first {0} rows, the most one export holds. Add a filter or a date range to export the rest.
texts.Reporting_Home_Help: Reports list, count and total records across BarnCRM objects and the modules installed, including fields of related records. Dashboards place reports side by side under shared filters. Everything runs with your own access, so two people opening the same dashboard each see only what they may read. Save a report or dashboard to keep it, and share it with people or public groups.
texts.Reporting_Home_NoDashboardsHelp: Open a template above or select New Dashboard. Dashboards shared with you show here too.
texts.Reporting_Home_NoObjects: There is nothing you can report on yet. Ask your BarnCRM admin for access to the records you work with.
texts.Reporting_Home_NoReportsHelp: Select New Report to build one. Reports shared with you show here too.
texts.Reporting_Home_Purpose: Reports and dashboards across your BarnCRM records
texts.Reporting_Home_SavedCap: Only the first {0} saved reports and dashboards are listed, in name order. Delete your own that are no longer needed to make room.
texts.Reporting_Home_TemplatesHelp: Ready-made dashboards for the modules installed. Open one to use it, change it, and save your own copy.
texts.Reporting_MoreGroups: There are more groups than shown. Add a filter or a date range to narrow it.
texts.Reporting_Partial: Totals cover the first {0} records only. Add a filter or a date range to include everything.
texts.Reporting_Problem_Chart: A chart needs a grouping. Add one under Groups and Totals, or show it as a table.
texts.Reporting_Problem_Columns: Add a column to list, or a total to count.
texts.Reporting_Problem_Measure: A grouping needs a total. Add one under Groups and Totals.
texts.Reporting_Problem_Metric: A metric shows one total with no grouping. Remove the groupings, or pick another display.
texts.Reporting_Scanning: Totalling a large report: {0} records read.
texts.Reporting_Share_Intro: People you add see the report or dashboard, run with their own access. Can Edit lets them change and save it. A public group shares it with its direct members as they are now (not the members of groups inside it); share again to include people who join later.
texts.Reporting_Stopped: Stopped after {0} records. These totals are partial.
